description: Gate generator whose gate length is a fraction of the clock period; also a clock divider and multiplier

params.text: Gate length as a proportion of the clock period, from 1ms to the full period; at maximum the output stays high
How many clock pulses the period spans, 1 to 64
How many gates are emitted within that period, 1 to 64

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the gate length, attenuated by the LENGTH knob
A 0-10V CV choosing the division, attenuated by the CLK DIV knob; with that knob at 4, 0-2.5V picks 1, 2.5-5V picks 2, and so on
Clears the measured period and the divider count
A 0-10V CV choosing the multiplication, attenuated by the CLK MUL knob
The incoming clock, measured pulse to pulse

outputs.text: The gate, 0-10V by default, with 0-5V, 10V either way and 5V either way on the menu

menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, CLOCK input or LEN input
RESET mode — Hard: reset clock period and divider throws away the measured clock period as well; Soft: reseet clock divider leaves the measurement alone
Initial clock — a slider setting the clock period assumed between the first clock pulse and the second, 500ms by default
Range — the voltage the gate output covers: 0V-10V, 0V-5V, +/-10V or +/-5V
